ai.gatewayHint: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for this project, with your own provider keys, budgets and a request log in the project's database.
ai.starting: Starting. This usually takes about a minute.
ai.notInStack: This project's stack has no AI gateway.
ai.switchOnCloud: Switching AI on adds a container to the project, which restarts the database once.
ai.switchOnLocal: This starts the AI gateway in the project's Docker stack.
ai.switchOffBody: Its models, keys and budgets are kept. Calls to the gateway stop until you switch it on again.

models.name: Name
models.internetHint: How far this model may reach while it answers: nothing on the public internet, its provider, or its provider and that provider's web tools.
models.removeBody: Calls naming this model will be refused. Its past usage is kept.
models.rateHint: Input and output go together. Left empty, the shipped catalogue's price is used if it has one.
models.cacheReadRate: Cache read, dollars per million tokens
models.cacheWriteRate: Cache write, dollars per million tokens

accessLevel.granted: The users and groups it is granted to

grants.zero: Granted to no user or group.

models.maxOutputHint: The reply length asked for when a caller names none.
models.cachingHint: Sends cache breakpoints to this model.
models.reasoningHint: How this model is asked to reason.
models.embeddingsHint: The request body this model takes for embeddings.
models.quota: What it may be sent in a minute
models.quotaHint: The provider's limit for this model, which the gateway keeps to.

fits.hint: Automatic choice picks among models that state these, and every route leaves out a model a request does not fit.
fits.jsonSchema: Holds a reply to a JSON schema
fits.noData: The account behind it keeps nothing from its calls

grants.title: Granted to
grants.empty: No one yet. Only the project's own keys can call it.
grants.hint: A grant applies at once, without saving.

routes.hint: A name callers send in place of a model. It tries its models in turn when one fails.
routes.name: Name
routes.nameHint: What a caller sends as the model. A route named auto is this project's own policy for automatic choice.
routes.fromFile: Set in the gateway's providers file
routes.removeBody: This name stops standing for these models.
routes.weightHint: From 1 to 1000. A larger weight draws this model more often.

sortHint.order: Tries the models in the order listed.
sortHint.latency: Tries the model quickest to its first byte first, as measured, with models not yet measured ahead of them.
sortHint.throughput: Tries the model with the most tokens per second first, as measured, with models not yet measured ahead of them.
sortHint.weighted: Draws a model in proportion to the weights, health and remaining quota.
sortHint.balanced: Draws a model in proportion to price, health, speed, remaining quota and the weights together.

routes.constraintsHint: The route uses the models that state they meet these.
routes.regionsHint: The regions a model may run in, separated by commas.
routes.maxPrompt: Most per million prompt tokens, in dollars
routes.maxCompletion: Most per million completion tokens, in dollars

providers.hint: Where the models run. A key is checked with the provider before it is kept, and it is never read back.
providers.name: Name
providers.keyHint: Stored in the project's own database.
providers.firstModelHint: The provider's own id. The key is checked against this model.
providers.nameTaken: A provider has that name already.
providers.authHeaderHint: The header the key is sent in. Left empty, the provider's own way.

keys.hint: For a program calling this gateway. A key is shown once, when it is made.
keys.onlyTime: Copy {name} now. It will not be shown again.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeBody: Programs using this key stop working at once.
keys.expiresHint: Left empty, it does not expire.

budgets.hint: How much may be spent before calls stop, or before a warning is logged.
budgets.name: Name
budgets.hardLabel: Stop calls when it is reached
budgets.invalid: Give an amount of zero or more.
budgets.removeBody: Spending under it is no longer capped.
budgets.removeLimitBody: Calls under it are no longer limited.

limits.hint: How fast calls may be made.

ai.numberInvalid: Each number field takes a number.

common.name: Name
common.notRunningStart: The project is not running. Start it from Overview to use this section.

copy.toCloudHint: Users, database, files, functions and their secrets, into a new or existing cloud project. This project stays as it is.
copy.toLocalHint: Users, database and files, into a local project. This project stays as it is.

cron.deleteBody: The job stops and is removed. Its run history stays in cron.job_run_details.
cron.intro: SQL that runs on a schedule, inside this database, with pg_cron.
cron.notInImage: pg_cron is not in this database's image.
cron.runsAsOwner: Each job runs as the owner, while the project is running; a time that passes while it is stopped is not caught up. A job scheduled from SQL anywhere shows up here too.
cron.syntax: Cron syntax in UTC, or "N seconds" for 1 to 59 seconds.
cron.title: Scheduled jobs

dataApi.clientIntro: @snoutdata/client is the client, with no dependencies. The two keys it takes are on Overview: the app key in a browser, where your row-level security decides what it can reach, and the server key on a server, where nothing does.
dataApi.everyTable: Every table and view in the public schema, at {api}{path}<table>.
dataApi.firstFive: The first five rows, read past row-level security.
dataApi.intro: REST at {api}{rest} and GraphQL at {api}{graph}, both generated from this database's own tables. One switch turns on both.
dataApi.noTables: No tables in public yet. Create one in the SQL editor on this project's connection.
dataApi.notRunning: The project is not running. Start it from Overview to read its tables.
dataApi.tryIt: Try it with the server key

ext.intro: What this database's image carries, read off the database itself. {count} on. The owner may switch on the ones the image delegates to it.
ext.notDelegatedHint: Not in the list the image delegates to the owner; creating it may be refused
ext.offBody: This drops the extension and its own objects. Postgres refuses if anything of yours still depends on it, and says what.
ext.title: Extensions

realtime.intro: A table in the {publication} publication sends every insert, update and delete to listeners of changes, filtered by your row-level security. Signals and the roster need no table.
realtime.noSubs: Nobody is subscribed to database changes right now.

sql.control: That value contains a control character and will not be sent as a literal.

statements.intro: What the database remembers about the statements it has run (pg_stat_statements), normalised so no literal is in it, heaviest first. Statements other roles ran (auth, the data API) are hidden from this login.
statements.title: Postgres statements

storage.drop: Or drop files anywhere on this card.
storage.emptyBody: Every file in it is deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage.noBuckets: No buckets yet. A bucket holds files; its policies (or being public) decide who may read them.
storage.nowPrivate: Files are read through your policies now.
storage.nowPublic: Anyone with a file's URL can read it now.
storage.removeBody: Storage refuses while it still holds files. Empty it first to delete them too.
storage.replace: Replace files with the same name
storage.servedHint: Public files are served at {url}<path> without a key. Private ones need a signed URL or a policy that lets the caller read them.

ts.existingHint: An existing table with a timestamp column. It becomes a partitioned series in place.
ts.intro: SnoutTime partitions a table by time, seals old partitions into a compressed columnar form, keeps rollups up to date and drops what is past its retention.
ts.none: No series yet. Make one from a table with a time column below.
ts.notInImage: SnoutTime is not in this project's database image, so there is nothing to switch on here. It runs on SnoutData Cloud projects; when the self-hosted image carries it, this section offers it.
ts.seriesIntro: SnoutTime {version}. Every figure is from the catalog or a planner estimate, never a scan.
ts.title: Time series

users.banned: Banned. Their sessions stop working when they next refresh.
users.deleteBody: The user and their sessions are deleted. Rows of yours that reference them keep whatever your foreign keys say.
users.none: No users yet. Add one below, or sign one up from your app.

view.clusterCloud: A cluster is for SnoutData Cloud projects.
view.containersLocal: A container is your own image, running beside the project for as long as it runs. Containers run on SnoutData Cloud only: a local project has no container runner. Run your image with your own Docker beside it, or copy this project to the cloud from Settings.
view.gone: This project is no longer in the list.
view.logsHint: The project's activity log (every change, by whom) is on the dashboard. Postgres's own record of the statements it has run is here.
view.notInAccount: This project is not in your account any more.
view.paused: The project is paused. Start it from Overview to use this section.

workOn.runHint: a new SQL editor on this database
workOn.title: Work on it
